title: backend-skeleton impact surface baseline
description: Validates specs/<feature_id>/impact-baseline.json, written only by `bskel impact accept` -- a projection of ONE feature's own public surface at the moment it was last accepted as the reference point for change detection. Git-independent by design (specs/ is commonly gitignored, see D-contract-history's own finding) -- this file itself is the durable record of 'what did this feature's surface look like last time a human/CI accepted it'. Every *_shape_hash is sha256(JSON.stringify(sortKeysDeep(subtree))), the exact canonicalization lib/attest.mjs already implements and is reused unchanged (see D-attestation-payload-completeness's K1). See D-cross-feature-impact-graph.

fields.description: Only fields named by a declared dependencies.json edge -- this project has no per-adapter field enumerator (see D-field-dependency's own EXIT), so a field only exists here where something else already named it. Keyed "<ResourceType>.<field>".
